author: CollinRugg
text:
Singer Ed Sheeran appears to read an apology after Macklemore was kicked off the tour for his pro-Palestine rant.

Sheeran, who is from England, said what happened to Macklemore “should never happen in the free world.”

“I want my music and shows to be about unity, not division, about humanity, not politics.”
